manual_finding: V72 reduces grain relative to originalRAW8k at equal32000 examples but leaves strong colored noise in high-ISO smooth areas. Both RawNIND gain adapters remove much more noise on these selected crops, though their boundaries/details remain soft and imperfect. AHD low-noise reference is auxiliary, not exact RGB GT. All16 triplets represented/viewed in native board; no resizing. No promotion.
scope: Full existing4known/5unseen development scenes,72/90crops, two NN checkpoints at equal32000 example budget plus two RawNIND observed-CFA adapters and3classical. Seven methods:504/630records. CPUFP32/NCHW, no GPU work or reuse into the pending CUDA panel. V72 changes units/trainingprecision/grouping together; not a one-factor ablation. Source-balanced means and scene bootstrap, not training-repeat uncertainty. No new data, protected-final scoring, training, schedule/queue edits, full-frame result, automatic continuation or promotion.
limitations: CPUFP32/NCHW only, batch1. V72 differs from oldV71 in units, training precision and optimizer grouping together. Source/scene bootstrap is not training-repeat uncertainty. Known/unseen are development subsets; publisher model training exposure is not fully certified. No V43/V63 primary recomputation, complete photographic/analytic/color/DINO review or full-frame performance result here; pending CUDA review remains unchanged. Protected-final stays closed. Saved camera denoisedF32 arrays are not replayed; outer PNG panels are reconstructed from hashed prepared noisy/AHD data with the production display operator.
